answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 183071 Country: India Title: Earning money by lying Question: I worked in a school as a teacher I lied and took more money than I had to deposit to in board office and bought a bike with that money, I realized after some years that this is wrong, so what should I do now? Answer ID: 183071 Posted on: Oct 21, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 261/173/M=3/1443) You should return to the office as much money you have earned by lying and do taubah and istighfar for the sin of lying. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
